lead_headline: Villa Tourism in Kaş and Kalkan to Peak in July
lead_deck: Villa stays in the region are expected to reach their highest level in July.
lead_body: Villa tourism in the Kaş and Kalkan regions has gained momentum due to the summer season. Sector representatives predict that occupancy rates will peak in July.
The increase in holidaymakers' preference for villas is directly reflected in the region's economy and accommodation capacity.
